subject: Unable to dispatch task for application=201582, there are 1 tasks in progress

messages.author: 181bcebaf89c73b8
messages.subject: Unable to dispatch task for application=201582, there are 1 tasks in progress
parts:
rsconnect hung during deployment, and now when I try to deploy I get an error (code 409) saying there was a problem on the server (as a dialog) and "Unable to dispatch task for application=201582, there are 1 tasks in progress". I can't terminate the app using rsconnect::terminateApp or thorough the shinyapps web interface. 

Is there a way of force killing in progress tasks? 

Thanks

David. 

P.S. This is for https://leafvis.shinyapps.io/leafvis2/
